rdfs:label: valid
rdfs:comment: The date or period of validity of the resource — when it should be considered current and applicable.
notes: Use for time-bounded resources — coupons, certificates, regulations, embargoed reports. Value is a date, dateTime, or ISO 8601 interval literal; for a structured period use a `urn:solid:PeriodOfTime` resource. Distinct from `urn:solid:available` (when it became obtainable) and `urn:solid:issued` (when it was published).

history.note: Range rdfs:Literal (intervals are not xsd:dateTime); notes mention urn:solid:PeriodOfTime. Added urn:solid:temporal to notToBeConfusedWith (reciprocal).
